name: SAFARI VISUAL VIEWPORT CITY SEARCH FIX
changes: Positions city and warehouse sheets inside Safari's live visual viewport above the keyboard
Recalculates sheet geometry during visualViewport resize, scroll, browser-bar movement and page scroll
Uses an absolute body portal so iOS cannot hide the sheet behind the software keyboard
Keeps remembered city text searchable instead of incorrectly switching Nova Poshta autocomplete to manual mode
Clears unverified remembered warehouse text until the city is selected from Nova Poshta
Preserves fast cached search, request cancellation, courier delivery and single-warehouse autoselect
Bumped live assets and PWA cache to RC25
